label: Approach
heading: We underwrite like engineers: margins of safety first, upside second.
lede: Every deal has to survive conservative assumptions before we look at what could go right. These four rules decide whether we buy.

rules.title: Buy at a discount
rules.body: We target purchase prices meaningfully below our estimate of stabilized value. The discount is our first line of protection if anything goes wrong.

rules.title: Underwrite what is real
rules.body: We price deals on in-place income, not the seller’s pro forma, and test them against both market and stabilized cap rates.

rules.title: Price capex with our own crews
rules.body: Our construction team scopes and prices the renovation before we make an offer, so the budget comes from the people who will do the work.

rules.title: Borrow conservatively
rules.body: Moderate leverage, fixed or capped rates, and stress tests on interest rate and debt coverage. If a deal only works with aggressive rent growth, we walk away.
